title: A run goes past its money limit when run in parallel
what: With runs in parallel (-j 4) the money ceiling is passed: --max-cost-usd 4 ran to $6.32. The ceiling is enforced by `claude plugin eval` (the flag is only passed on: bin/ci:68, evals/judge-measure/README.md:27-28), so relay's lever is the number it passes: the cap minus one batch at -j 4, or -j 1 near the cap.
why: A cost ceiling that overshoots spends the owner's money past the number they set.
failing_case: `--max-cost-usd 4` at `-j 4` ran to $6.32 (Sonnet measure, 22 Oct); the README's $10 ceiling can reach about $13; should stop within one batch of the ceiling (handover "ceiling overshoot", "eval cost ceiling not firm at -j 4", check-readme-cost "$10 ceiling worst case ~$13")
